run_merge_support_docs_finalize: run the merge_support_docs script with finalize mode to split collected docs into 3000-item slices
run_merge_support_docs_merge: run the merge_support_docs script with a slice number to merge docs from that slice directory
merge_non_eli_docs: merge non-ELI5 Common Crawl documents from JSON files in a directory and deduplicate by URL
setup_args: set up CLI arguments for the merge_support_docs script with name and finalize or slice number options
merge_support_docs_data_utils: merge ELI5 support documents from a slice directory using the data_utils merge_support_docs function
